Definition: middle voice from G4253 and the base of G5157; to turn forward for oneself, i.e. encourage:--exhort.
BiblicalUsage: Protrepomai means to turn forward, to encourage, to exhort. It appears once, when Apollos was disposed to pass into Achaia: the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him, and when he was come, he helped them much which had believed through grace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a word of encouragement from the brethren opened a whole province to Apollos, because the church that exhorts its workers sends them further than they could go alone.
